printplz_margin_note: Estimates use the lowest variant price (range shown when variants exist). Formula: gross item price plus buyer shipping charged, minus Printful product cost, minus Printful US first-item shipping when Etsy offers free shipping, minus Etsy fees (6.5% transaction on item + shipping charged, 3% processing + $0.25, and $0.20 listing). Excludes ads, Offsite Ads, sales-tax handling and Printful billing-currency effects. Tee product/shipping costs are marked est. because the workspace source notes explicitly assume youth/toddler shipping.
